title: Dezhou Jennies' Diet and Microbiota Analysis
summary: This cluster focuses on the dietary habits and microbiota of Dezhou jennies. The animals were fed yeast hydrolysate, which contains mannan oligosaccharides and nucleotides, and also received a basal diet. Analysis of their serum biochemical parameters showed higher triglyceride levels and lower Alanine Aminotransferase and Aspartate Aminotransferase levels compared to other groups. The microbiota of Dezhou jennies was found to consist of various bacterial phyla, including Actinomycetota, Arcanobacterium, Bacillota, Bacteroidota, Corynebacterium, Fusobacteriota, Patescibacteria, and Porphyromonas. The study's conceptualization is attributed to H.Z. and R.W.
